description: A grounding yoga and mobility posture that gently elongates the latissimus dorsi, lumbar spine, and hip extensors.
setup: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees separated slightly wider than torso width.
steps: Sit hips back onto your heels and lengthen spine upward.
Fold forward at the hips, walking hands out along floor until forehead rests gently on mat.
Extend fingertips forward to lengthen through lats while sinking hips deeply toward heels.
Breathe deeply into ribcage and lower back for assigned duration.
cues: Sink hips heavy toward heels on every exhale
Reach fingers forward while relaxing armpits toward floor

mistakes.mistake: Holding breath or shallow chest breathing
mistakes.fix: Focus on slow belly breaths, feeling back ribs expand

mistakes.mistake: Hips popping up high into air due to tight ankles or hips
mistakes.fix: Place a folded towel under hips or widen knees slightly for comfort

rep_standard: Maintain static hold with relaxed neck and deep nasal breathing for full assigned duration
